Before we begin

A few helpful answers.

What kinds of properties do you work on?

We work across residential, commercial, institutional and hospitality environments. The scope is tailored to each site and its requirements.

Can you improve an existing garden?

Yes. Garden renovation, landscape enhancement, lawn work, planting and maintenance can help improve an existing outdoor space.

Do you offer natural and artificial options?

Yes. Our services include natural and artificial grass, turf and vertical gardens. The choice depends on the intended use, site conditions, appearance and maintenance needs.

What should I prepare before discussing a project?

A location, a few photographs, approximate dimensions and a description of how you want to use the space make a useful starting point. A budget range and preferred timeline also help guide the discussion.

How are the budget and timeline decided?

These depend on the site, scale, materials and scope of work. Project planning considers your budget, execution requirements and expectations before the work begins.
